correctness.rationale: The forest Fourier-character expansion gives total vertex weight 16 and all eight facet weights 8; no nonempty forest edge subset has singleton odd-degree boundary. The absolute 4-simplex determinant is invariant under cube-coordinate reflections. Independent sign flips of any tree edge correlation are realizable by spin reflections, so the degree<=5 in each rho variable restricts to degree<=2 in each t=rho². Exact polynomial interpolation is therefore justified at squared nodes 0,1,4, including formally negative weights at rho=2 (only an algebraic identity is asserted there). A newly implemented 4x4 determinant enumerator verified all 4368 five-subsets, the histogram (1360,2672,320,16) for determinant absolute sizes 0,1,2,3, and all 16*27=432 integer interpolation identities. The bracket Q=Q0+aQ1 has Q1=15-7(b+c)-bc>=0 and Q-(1-a)Q_a=90+22(b+c)-6bc+2a[15-7(b+c)-bc]>0 for a,b,c in [0,1), proving strict monotonicity and unique equality at zero correlations. These complete finite polynomial coefficients plus symbolic degree/evenness yield the continuous-domain result.
